response.sql: WITH type_avg AS (SELECT e.type AS event_type, AVG(CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount <> 0 GROUP BY e.type) SELECT event_type, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM type_avg) AS diff_from_mean FROM type_avg ORDER BY event_type
